repository_precheck.failed_prior_run_reason: archive_integrity_match gate returned false; later attempts succeeded

findings.description: The prior capture stored a conservative pipeline receipt timestamp but did not clearly distinguish a pre-existing baseline state from a newly published report event. This could misclassify the initial baseline as an event observation if consumers ignored receipt_kind. No scheduled capture had run; no live data was mislabeled.
The BPR parser converted blank long/short positions and percentages to numeric zero. Explicit zeros are printed as numeric 0 in the source; blank numeric fields must remain UNKNOWN.
Latest report selection relied on the first Futures link. Selection now sorts the encoded report month and validates report-date month.
A single-latest-link capture could miss multiple newly indexed catch-up reports. Protocol v2 compares the full futures-link set and captures all newly appearing URLs.

protocol_v2.newly_indexed_urls: captured append-only at actual report-page receipt time and event eligible after scheduled time gate
protocol_v2.latest_report_revision: re-fetched each scheduled run; new hash appended as revision
protocol_v2.catch_up_reports: all newly appearing report URLs captured in one scheduled run
protocol_v2.index_snapshots: append-only raw index HTML plus URL-set/hash/receipt records
protocol_v2.manual_dispatch: non-PIT and does not advance scheduled index baseline
protocol_v2.legacy_protocol_v1_metadata: ignored for v2 bootstrap; forces a fresh baseline

parser_semantics.combined_net_from_total_row: allowed only when both total long and short observed
parser_semantics.combined_net_from_category_rows: allowed when both category rows are complete
parser_semantics.category_breakdown: UNKNOWN if any category position is blank
